title: plan-load.v1
description: S055 §5.3 — output of the bob-serial-exec `plan-load` stage. A read-only agent validates work-packages.v1, verifies sha256(plan)==plan_hash, and returns a topological wp_order. Consumed by the bob-serial-exec script to drive STRICTLY SERIAL execution. Host-neutral data.

hash_ok.description: True iff sha256(plan-on-disk) == plan_hash. False => the script aborts PARTIAL needs: plan-recompile.

wp_order.description: Topologically-sorted WP ids (dependency order). Each id corresponds to one bob stage.

cycles_detected.description: Any dependency cycles found (should be empty for a valid DAG).
